intro: The Aberdeen & Old Town zone covers the older centre of Sri Vijaya Puram, the city officially called Port Blair until 2024: Aberdeen Bazaar, the shopping centre, Phoenix Bay with its inter-island jetty, and Haddo. Aberdeen and Haddo were already named stations of the penal settlement by 1871, and in 1944 the civil administration set up its headquarters near Aberdeen Bazaar. For a family looking for a tutor, that history shows up today as a close mix of shops, government offices, quarters blocks and family houses around the clock tower and the bay, so addresses are usually given by lane and landmark rather than by house number.

Schooling here is unusually varied in language. Haddo has Hindi-medium and Telugu-medium government senior secondary schools on the CBSE list, alongside English- and Telugu-medium primary schools, and Aberdeen has a Tamil-medium primary school. The syllabus is CBSE either way, because the islands' secondary and senior secondary schools are CBSE-affiliated, but the classroom language differs. When you post a request, name both the board and the medium. A tutor who can move between English and the child's school language can make a tricky mathematics or science step clearer, especially in the primary and middle classes, when a child is still building subject vocabulary.

Timing decides most arrangements in this zone. Evening shoppers fill the bazaar lanes, and passengers gather at Phoenix Bay around ship days, so families often pick a fixed slot that avoids both. NXTutors matches each request with two or three tutors, looking first at those who live in the locality, then at tutors who travel into Aberdeen & Old Town, then across the city, and finally online. You see each tutor's fee before the first class, which is a free demo, and you can switch tutors later without paying anything extra. Online lessons can cover any subject that no nearby tutor teaches.
faqs: Which localities make up the Aberdeen & Old Town zone?

Aberdeen Bazaar, Phoenix Bay and Haddo. All three appear among the 41 revenue villages of the Port Blair tehsil, and Aberdeen and Haddo were stations of the penal settlement by 1871. Together they form the compact older centre around the clock tower and the bay, with shops, offices and homes side by side.
Can I ask for a tutor who teaches in Hindi, Tamil or Telugu in this zone?

Yes, mention the language in your request. Schools here teach in several mediums, including Hindi- and Telugu-medium senior secondary schools at Haddo and a Tamil-medium primary school at Aberdeen, while following the CBSE syllabus. A tutor who shares the child's school language can make explanations easier to follow.
Is a weekday or weekend slot easier near Aberdeen Bazaar and Phoenix Bay?

Either can work if it avoids the busy times. The bazaar is crowded on shopping evenings, and Phoenix Bay is busy when inter-island ships depart, such as the weekly sailing to Campbell Bay. A weekday early evening or a weekend morning is usually simplest for a visiting tutor.
How much do home tutors charge in Aberdeen & Old Town?

Across NXTutors, most home-tuition sessions fall between ₹800 and ₹2,500 an hour; Classes 11–12, IB/IGCSE and JEE/NEET sit toward the upper end; specialists for IB HL or JEE Advanced can charge more. Each tutor sets their own fee, and NXTutors shows it on the profile before you book the free first demo.

intro: Junglighat & Central Localities groups five residential neighbourhoods in the middle of Sri Vijaya Puram: Junglighat, Delanipur, School Line, Dairy Farm and Bathubasti. Junglighat, Dairy Farm and School Line are revenue villages of the Port Blair tehsil, and Delanipur is recorded as an area of the city. Housing mixes family houses on lanes, government quarters blocks and, around the Bathubasti bazaar, multi-storey apartment buildings with rental homes. The civic body, which now styles itself Sri Vijaya Puram Municipal Council, dates from 2 October 1957 and has had 24 wards since its limits were widened in 2015, and these localities sit within it.

This zone has several government schools on the Directorate of Education's CBSE list: secondary schools at Junglighat, Dairy Farm and Delanipur, and a senior secondary school at School Line. That shapes what families ask a tutor for. Primary and middle-school children usually need steady help with reading, mathematics and homework, Class 9 and 10 students want CBSE board practice with sample papers, and from Class 11 the subjects become physics, chemistry, mathematics, biology and accountancy. Students from schools that stop at Class 10 may move schools for Class 11, so the first months of that year are a sensible point to start tuition.

A tutor from a neighbouring locality can often take a regular evening slot here, which makes weekday routines easier to arrange than on the city's edge. Share the lane name and a landmark, and for apartment buildings the floor, flat number and visitor parking. Start before the evening market rush if you live near the Bathubasti bazaar. NXTutors sends two or three matched tutors for each request, searching your own locality first, then the rest of the zone, then the wider city and online teachers. The fee is shown before you book a free demo, and changing tutor later costs nothing.
faqs: Which central localities does this zone include?

Junglighat, Delanipur, School Line, Dairy Farm and Bathubasti, also written Bathu Basti. They are residential neighbourhoods in the middle of Sri Vijaya Puram, and three of them, Junglighat, Dairy Farm and School Line, are revenue villages of the Port Blair tehsil in the district administration's list.
Where can a student in the central localities study up to Class 12?

At School Line, which has a government senior secondary school on the Directorate of Education's CBSE list. Junglighat, Dairy Farm and Delanipur have government secondary schools on the same list, so students there may change school after Class 10 and can find tutoring helpful during that move.
What details help a tutor visiting a flat in Bathubasti or a quarters block?

The floor and flat number, or the block and quarter number, plus where a visitor can park. Bathubasti has multi-storey apartment buildings alongside houses, and the central localities also include government quarters. For a family house on a lane, a landmark and the lane name are usually enough.
What do I see before booking a tutor in the central localities?

Each matched tutor's fee, on their NXTutors profile, before anything is booked. You get two or three options for one request, the first class with your choice is a free demo, and if things change later you can move to a different tutor without any added charge.

intro: The Expansion Villages zone covers the growing edge of Sri Vijaya Puram: Dollygunj, Garacharma, Prothrapur, Brookshabad and Austinabad. In 2011 the Andaman and Nicobar administration planned to add ten villages next to the town to the municipal limits, citing a substantial rise in housing and commercial activity, and the city limits were expanded in 2015. Garacharma is a census town just outside the city, Prothrapur is one of the larger settlements of South Andaman Island, and only parts of Brookshabad and Austinabad were named in the plan. Many homes are houses on their own plots, and property portals still list residential plots here.

Tutoring here is shaped by distance from the centre more than by board, since children follow CBSE like the rest of the islands. Prothrapur has its own government senior secondary school on the CBSE list, so students there can study through Class 12 locally, and Garacharma and Dollygunj have government schools on the district directory. Tutors based in the centre may come out only on certain days, so families often agree two fixed weekday slots, or a weekend home class combined with online sessions. That pattern also suits the monsoon months, when shorter evening journeys make the routine easier to keep going.

Addresses are the first thing to get right. Newer lanes and plotted homes are not always easy to find by house number, so share a map pin and a landmark before the demo; in a house the tutor usually comes straight to the door. Fix the slot around school bus and work timings. NXTutors offers two or three matched tutors per request: tutors in your locality first, then those who travel into the zone, then the whole city, and online tutors when nobody nearby fits. Fees are visible before the free demo, and switching to another tutor later is free of charge.
faqs: Why are these five localities grouped as Expansion Villages?

Because each was named in the administration's 2011 plan to bring villages next to the town into the Port Blair municipal limits, some of them only in part. The plan cited a substantial rise in housing and commercial activity there, and the city limits were expanded in 2015.
Do tutors from central Sri Vijaya Puram come out to these localities?

Some do, often on fixed days rather than every evening. Agree the weekly pattern before the demo, and consider a home class at the weekend with online sessions on weekdays. This suits Classes 11 and 12, where families on the edge of the city sometimes find fewer tutors nearby.
Can a Prothrapur or Garacharma student get senior-class tutoring locally?

Often, yes. Prothrapur has a government senior secondary school on the CBSE list, and Class 11 and 12 science, commerce and mathematics are the usual tuition needs there. Garacharma has a government school on the district directory. For a specialist subject, pairing a home tutor with an online teacher is practical.
Will NXTutors suggest online tutors for homes on the city's edge?

Yes, when no nearby home tutor fits. NXTutors first looks for tutors living in or travelling to your locality, then across the zone and the city, and adds online options after that. You receive two or three matches and see each fee before the free first demo.
